description: This file contains unit tests for the ChangeLogVersions class in the org.openmrs.liquibase package, verifying the correctness of version listing and changelog filename generation related to Liquibase database migrations.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersionsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ChangeLogVersions, testing version retrieval and changelog filename generation logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ChangeLogVersions before each test.

methods.name: shouldGetSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Verifies that the snapshot versions listed in ChangeLogVersions match the actual files in the specified resource folders.

methods.name: shouldGetUpdateVersions
methods.description: Checks that the update versions listed in ChangeLogVersions align with the actual update changelog files.

methods.name: shouldGetChangeLogNameFromVersions
methods.description: Tests the method that generates changelog filenames from a list of version strings.

methods.name: compareActualAndExpectedChangeLogs
methods.description: Helper method that compares expected changelog filenames against actual resource filenames for correctness.

methods.name: getChangelogNamesFromVersions
methods.description: Generates a list of changelog filenames by appending version strings to a base filename.

methods.name: lookupLiquibaseChangeLogs
methods.description: Resolves resource files matching a pattern and returns their filenames sorted alphabetically.
